description: Create or overwrite a file in `agent`'s scripts/ folder with `content`, or delete it with remove=true. `name` is a bare filename of up to 32 characters (letters, digits, . _ -, no leading dot or dash, no paths). Refused while the agent still has the default api_key, and once a write.lock file is in the folder. Writing write.lock (any content) locks every script write, and this tool can then no longer change or remove it. The lock does not stop runs: a script run with mcp_script_run that deletes files can remove write.lock, as can a shell (Pi) or USB (Pico, ESP32).
name: mcp_script_write
